entries.source: Sook's Runes and other Harmless Contraptions
It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, only 3 times bigger than a normal wolf. It looks hungry. You look tasty!
entries.target: 这是一只狡诈的狼，只有普通狼的3倍大。它看起来很饥渴，而你——很美味！

entries.source: You were not the first here: the corpse was turned into an undead.
entries.target: 你不是第一个来到这里的：那个人的尸体已经变成了亡灵！

entries.source: Small and bloodshot. Its dead gaze still burns your skin.
entries.target: 小而充血。它死去后的凝视仍灼痛着你的皮肤。

entries.source: You have no stat points left!
